data.sentence: Welcome to Aegis, Helena and Tobias. We're really glad to be starting this with you.
Thanks, Lisa. We're glad too. It was a close evaluation, so I'll tell you what tipped it.
We looked hard at SentinelShield and VaultEdge. Honestly, on features alone it was close.
What decided it was how you handled the March outage. Keystone's CISO walked us through your game day summary, including what failed.
A vendor that shows me its own failures is one I trust to tell me about mine.
That means a lot to the engineering team. They debated for a long time whether to share the partition test result.
Let's talk about the plan. You're starting with Detect and Comply, and Identity in phase two.
Right. We're a credit union with about nine hundred staff and thirty branches, mostly on CloudPrime, with some on-prem core banking.
The core banking system is the sensitive part. It can't take an agent, so we'd need agentless log collection.
That's supported through LogVault. We'd forward syslog from a collector in your data center, so nothing is installed on the core system.
Good, that was my main worry.
For Detect, the first seven days are observation mode. It learns your baselines without paging anyone, so your team isn't flooded on day one.
I like that. We've heard from Brightpath that tuning made a big difference to their alert volume.
It did. We'll schedule a tuning session at the end of week two using your own alert data.
On compliance, we're examined by the NCUA, and we also do SOC 2 for our fintech partners.
Comply v2 covers SOC 2 natively. The NCUA examination framework isn't built in yet, but most of its controls map onto FFIEC, which we do support.
Can you send that mapping? Our examiner will ask.
Yes, I'll put together a control mapping between FFIEC and the NCUA requirements for your examiner.
What's the timeline end to end?
About five weeks for Detect and Comply. Week one is collectors and integrations, week two observation mode, then tuning, then go-live.
And you'll give us access to the pipeline health panel when it ships?
From day one of its release, yes. You'll have the heartbeat alerts routed to your SOC as well.
Perfect. This is a good start. Let's get the collectors scheduled.
Wonderful. I'll send the project plan and the collector requirements tomorrow.
